metadata.name: ManageLoanAccountNumber
metadata.description: This API is add/update loan account number against an existing account.

request_fields.name: Source
request_fields.description: Source of API Consumer For external system expected sources will be WEB. Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: IPAddress
request_fields.description: IP Address of Client / Application Hosting Server Example: 10.206.0.204 Allowable Values: 15

request_fields.name: DateFormat
request_fields.description: Place Holder for Future Use. Values are: 1 : MM/dd/yyyy HH:MM:SS (Default) 2 : MM/dd/yy HH:MM:SS 3 : dd/MM/yyyy HH:MM:SS Allowable Values: 25

request_fields.name: CurrencyCode
request_fields.description: Currency Code Place Holder for Future Use. Valid Values: Refer Appendix Section - Currency Code Example:840 = US Dollar Condition:If no value is passed, default value = 840 Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: CurrencySymbolType
request_fields.description: Place Holder for Future Use. CurrencySymbolType: 1: Currency Sign like $ 2: 3 ALPHA Currency Code like USD Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: Language
request_fields.description: Place Holder for Future Use. Language: en: means use English Default: en - English Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: ExternalIP
request_fields.description: IP Address of end user of API Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: SessionID
request_fields.description: Session identifier of the API Example: 000028;026;1349906692 Allowable Values: 100

request_fields.name: APIVersion
request_fields.description: Version of the API to be invoked. Example: 2.0 API Version Current Version 2.0 Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: CallerID
request_fields.description: Caller ID of source from where API is initiated it is End User Caller ID Example: 7204454214 (phone number applicable in Case of IVR) Allowable Values: 20

request_fields.name: CalledID
request_fields.description: Called ID of destination for which API is initiated It is Destination Called ID Example: 7314145404 (phone number applicable in Case of IVR) Allowable Values: 20

request_fields.name: RequestTime
request_fields.description: Request Date Time of API Format: MM/dd/yyyy HH:mm:ss Example:01/15/2020 10:05:23

request_fields.name: AdminNumber
request_fields.description: Details can be obtained by admin number (Embossing Acctid). Valid Values: 0-9 Format:XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX Example:1236547896325874 Condition:At least one of AdminNumber/AccountNumber/AccountUniversalUniqueID/AdminUniversalUniqueID is required.

request_fields.name: AccountNumber
request_fields.description: Account number of cardholder. Valid Values: 0-9 Format:XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX Example:1236547896325874 Condition:At least one of AdminNumber/AccountNumber/AccountUniversalUniqueID/AdminUniversalUniqueID is required. Allowable Values: 19

request_fields.name: Action
request_fields.description: Valid Values: 1 = Add 2 = Update 3 = Get Loan Account details

request_fields.name: Status
request_fields.description: Valid Values: 0 =  Inactive, 1 =  Active Status should be active for adding LoanAccountNumber and if not provided then default value is active

request_fields.name: PayeeName1
request_fields.description: Payee first name Condition: PayeeName1 is required if action is 1. Example: Alex Valid Value: a-z Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: PayeeName2
request_fields.description: Payee last name Example: Telles Valid Value: a-z Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: PayeeAddress1
request_fields.description: PayeeAddress1 Condition: PayeeAddress1 is required if action is 1. Example: 123 HWY Valid Values: a-z, 0-9 Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: PayeeAddress2
request_fields.description: Payee's Address2 Example: 123 HWY Valid Values: a-z, 0-9 Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: PayeeAddress3
request_fields.description: Payee's Address3 Example: 123 HWY Valid Values: a-z, 0-9 Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: PayeeCity
request_fields.description: PayeeCity Condition: PayeeCity is required if action is 1. Example: New York Valid Values: a-z Allowable Values: 25

request_fields.name: PayeeState
request_fields.description: PayeeState Example: NY Valid Values: a-z Condition: PayeeState is required if action is 1 (it can be statecode or state name). Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: PayeeZipCode
request_fields.description: PayeeZipCode Condition: PayeeZipCode is required if action is 1. Example: 178365 Valid Value: 0-9 Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: PayeeCountry
request_fields.description: PayeeCountry Condition: PayeeCountry is required if action is 1 (it can be country code or country name). Example: India Valid Value: a-z Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: LoanAccountNumber
request_fields.description: LoanAccountNumber which is to be added or updated. Valid Values: 19 digit number Example : 654789512301450039 Condition : Required in case of add and update. Allowable Values: 19

request_fields.name: AccountUUID
request_fields.description: Basesegment's Universal Unique Id. Condition:At least one of AdminNumber/AccountNumber/AccountUniversalUniqueID/AdminUniversalUniqueID is required. Valid Values:a-z,0-9 Example a585f533-0d33-4282-ab98-4852146e5e17 Allowable Values: 64

request_fields.name: AdminUUID
request_fields.description: EmbossingAccount's Universal Unique Id. Condition:At least one of AdminNumber/AccountNumber/AccountUniversalUniqueID/AdminUniversalUniqueID is required. Valid Values:a-z,0-9 Example b585f533-0d33-4282-ab98-4852146e5e17 Allowable Values: 64

request_fields.name: CustomerNameOnLoan
request_fields.description: CustomerNameOnLoan is the Borrower's name on the loan account. Example: John Dow Valid Value: a-z Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: PayeeAddress4
request_fields.description: PayeeAddress4 Fetched from Biller Directory Example: 123 HWY Valid Values: a-z, 0-9 Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: PayeeID
request_fields.description: Biller ID Example: 1485 Valid Value: 0-9 Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: MethodName
request_fields.description: Loan ID being used for Reward Redemption. Example: 4015 Valid Values:0-9 Allowable Values: 50

response_fields.name: Status
response_fields.description: API Status Example: Success - true, Error - false

response_fields.name: ErrorCode
response_fields.description: Response Message Error Code Allowable Values: 10
